thaumgiesis.crucible.mouth:
Left-click to dissolve
Right-click to add water or craft
thaumgiesis.crucible.guide: Left-click ingredients into the crucible. Right-click with a catalyst to craft.
thaumgiesis.crucible.dry: Right-click with a water bucket to fill the crucible.
thaumgiesis.crucible.heating: Heat the water from below until it boils.
thaumgiesis.crucible.no_recipe: No unlocked recipe matches this catalyst and the dissolved essentia.
